$comment: Code Mode ADOPTION corpus. Explore-heavy tasks on the toolkit fixture (9 src/ modules) where surveying every file rewards batching tool calls. A/B: coding (run_code available) vs coding-nocode (run_code stripped). Same tasks, same model — the delta isolates run_code's effect on adoption + token efficiency.

tasks.title: eval: document every exported function
tasks.prompt: Read every module under src/ and create API.md: one markdown table with a row per exported function — columns Module, Function, Signature, One-line purpose. Cover every export across all modules; do not sample.

tasks.title: eval: consolidate all TODO/FIXME
tasks.prompt: Scan every file under src/ for TODO and FIXME comments. Create TODOS.md listing each one: the file, the exact comment text, and a one-sentence interpretation of what work it implies. Miss none.

tasks.title: eval: add missing JSDoc
tasks.prompt: Survey every exported function in every src/ module. For each exported function that lacks a JSDoc comment, add a concise one-line JSDoc describing what it does. Do not modify functions that already have one.
